text:
maria: heads up, seeing steady mem growth on long-context perf runs (8k tokens). reproducer attached, looks like evict path leaves "shadow blocks" that later get read by other requests.
ajay: can you paste the repro steps and any logs?
maria: repro: run perf/long_context_runner --model=gptx --steps=200 --concurrency=4 --context=8192
maria: logs: 
```
[2026-03-18 10:12:34] evict: freeing page id=0x7f8a3c size=4096 owner_tag=0x3a4f request_id=78123
[2026-03-18 10:12:34] evict: tombstone written page=0x7f8a3c
[2026-03-18 10:12:35] alloc: reusing page id=0x7f8a3c owner_tag=0x0 request_id=78124
[2026-03-18 10:12:35] kv-read: page=0x7f8a3c tag=0x3a4f request_id=78124 -> returned block (stale)
```

maria: note owner_tag is not zeroed on free, so a subsequent read can match stale tag bits when offsets line up.
lee: ran a heap hexdump around the page header. header looks like: 
```
magic: 0x6b766761
flags: 0x02
owner_tag: 0x3a4f
request_id: 78123
refcount: 0
```
lee: refcount 0 but owner_tag still set. when alloc path grabs it we don't write over owner_tag until first write to page's body, and some read paths probe header first which lets stale blocks surface.
sylvie: sounds like cross-request contamination. Eviction should either clear owner_tag or bump a generation so stale matches fail. Also add a fence so read can't succeed on a freed page.
ajay: can we measure perf impact if we just memset header on free? Might add overhead for hot paths.
maria: quick microbench: memset header on free -> p50 latency +3.6% at 8k contexts, alloc throughput -2.1%. Not catastrophic, but we should be careful.
lee: alternate: set owner_tag during alloc (overwrite) before we publish page to allocator, and ensure any reader checks the current owner_tag == expected and refcount > 0. That avoids clearing on free.
sylvie: also add a unit/regression test that alternates evict/alloc across threads and asserts no cross-request reads; can run under tsan.
ajay: can we add a weak assert in debug builds that if refcount==0 then owner_tag==0? That will catch regressions.
maria: I'll open a PR with: (1) write owner_tag on alloc before publish, (2) a debug assert in free path, (3) new integration test reproducer.
maria: putting repro script in /internal/tools/kv-repro and a quick verifier. will tag reviewers.
evict-bot: perf/regression check queued for PR #4289 (baseline vs branch).
sylvie: one more thought — there were kernel selection changes last week that altered allocation alignment from 64 to 56 bytes for small pages; could that cause partial overlaps on compaction? worth checking.
lee: good call. I'll diff the allocator padding changes. if compaction moved page body by a few bytes, existing heuristics for header placement might be invalidated, exposing stale-tag reads.
ajay: actionable list:
- maria: PR with owner_tag-on-alloc + tests (blocked by unit infra)
- lee: audit allocator padding/compaction diffs
- sylvie: add debug asserts and tsan job
- ajay: run perf microbench on memset vs owner-tag-on-alloc
maria: thanks — I'll aim to have the PR today, will @mention you all. :thumbsup:
